# SK Tea Company (اس کے ٹی کمپنی)

> Premium Quality Tea Supplier & Wholesaler across Pakistan.
> Delivering premium rich aroma, rich color, and strong taste tea for shopkeepers, hotels, restaurants, and households.

## Brand Overview
- **Name**: SK Tea Company (SK Tea Co.)
- **Slogan**: Quality Tea, Trusted Service (معیاری چائے، قابل اعتماد سروس)
- **Specialty**: Pure, premium quality blended CTC and Danedar tea curated for rich taste, robust aroma, and deep golden color.
- **Languages Supported**: English, Urdu (اردو), and Roman Urdu.

## Available Pack Sizes & Specifications
- **125g Pack (0.125 KG)**: Compact trial and daily retail size for budget-conscious tea drinkers.
- **250g Pack (0.25 KG)**: Standard household favorite size.
- **500g Pack (0.50 KG)**: Value family pack for high-consumption households.
- **1 KG Pack (1.00 KG)**: Wholesale bulk pack designed for tea stalls, dhabas, hotels, retailers, and high-volume shopkeepers.

## Ordering & Service Details
- **Payment Methods**: Cash on Delivery (COD) and EasyPaisa Direct Transfer.
- **Delivery Coverage**: All cities and towns across Pakistan with direct door delivery.
- **Order Tracking**: Real-time status lookup using Order ID format `SKT-XXXXXX` (e.g., `SKT-000101`).
- **Official Invoice**: Instant printable computerized bill provided with every order with QR code verification.

## Key Features
- Online tea ordering portal with instant automatic KG weight calculation.
- Live order status tracking with timeline progression (New -> Confirmed -> Processing -> Out for Delivery -> Delivered).
- Direct WhatsApp instant order confirmation and customer inquiry routing.
- Shopkeeper and retailer bulk discount support.
